name: What are the advantages of using moisture-resistant drywall in a basement?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of using moisture-resistant drywall in a basement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Using moisture-resistant drywall, often called green board or purple board, in a basement offers significant advantages. Basements are inherently more susceptible to humidity and potential moisture issues compared to upper levels of a home. This specialized drywall is manufactured with an additive in its core paper to resist moisture and mildew growth. It provides an extra layer of protection against mold and mildew, which can compromise indoor air quality and structural integrity, making it a wise investment for basement environments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Moisture-resistant drywall helps prevent mold and mildew growth in basements, which are prone to humidity.
